interpretation: False positives against false negatives over the content-bearing channel. The excess is what licenses calling the residual loss OVER-GENERATION rather than an error-category attribution -- the wording that replaced a withdrawn claim about 'naming the wrong entity'. It is descriptive: it selects no threshold, certifies nothing, and identifies no error category either. Counts come from the frozen scorer the certifier uses, not a second implementation.

fs.construction: evaluation.evaluate_document per document over the content-bearing channel; excess is false_positives - false_negatives, stored so no guard has to subtract
